body:
Thanks for the quick response!

I imagine that would avert the validation problem, but then I wonder if it would be confusing for the user if they then deselected the second refinement (in the example, `Bamboo`). Presumably, they would then expect to see the results of the range input refinement they initially entered (50 to 100), but would instead see the results for the value set by the component (80 to 100).

Of course, it's entirely possible I'm misunderstanding how the logic would work out in practice, so perhaps it would behave as expected.
